offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. Hobby pay-as-you-go: 1,000 credits per $5.
offerings.price_basis: Hobby PAYG；按每次最多10个结果的基础搜索（2 credits/次）
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month；500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（titles、descriptions、URLs）；可选返回每个结果的完整 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots
offerings.note: 搜索费用按每10个结果向上取整；11–20结果为4 credits。Standard/Growth/Scale PAYG credits价格不同。
